searchText: So it looks like the new auto merger is not working. For some reason it fails to refresh its status once the checks pass. There is an active issue open and the devs appear to be very responsive. So I'm hoping they figure out a solution. In the meantime, it's important to note that users can edit anything about their post to refresh the merger. I will also re-implement the previous approach (both would be running) until the problems be fixed. As far as I can tell there is no better solution than Kodiak. All the others involve too much personal maintenance or are simply not functional. I will provide my time to Kodiak if necessary to build the solution (because we're sooo close 😭) Happy to hear and discuss possible alternative solutions, though...
